# Newport Sailing School and Tours

> Newport, Rhode Island's first and only pure sailing tour. Family owned and operated since 1965. Narrated sailing tours, ASA-certified sailing instruction, corporate team building, and custom private charters on Newport Harbor and Narragansett Bay. Newport's Finest Since 1971.

Location: 5 Marina Plaza, Goat Island Marina, Dock A5, Newport, RI 02840 (free parking at Dock A5 kiosk; cruises depart every 90 minutes, seasonal May–November).
Phone: (401) 848-2266
Email: info@newportsailing.com
Booking: FareHarbor (real-time online booking).

- [Home](index.html): Overview, what makes us special, reviews, location.

- [Sailing Instruction](sailing-instruction.html): Intro courses ($100–$495), ASA 101 Certification ($1,395), intermediate ($495).
- [Team Building](team-building.html): Corporate charters and custom team building events.
- [Custom Sailing Experiences](custom-sailing.html): Private, occasion-based charters.
- [About Us](about.html): Family history since 1965, Captain Mike, Colgate 26 fleet.
- [Gallery](gallery.html): Photos of sails, sunsets and scenery.
- [Reviews](reviews.html): Customer testimonials.
